status: Scenario specifications implemented by src/benchmark/fixtures.py; 15 scenarios used by the 18-task dataset.

setup_requirements: Create a healthy stateless HTTP Deployment api with two replicas and readiness/liveness probes.
healthy.reset: Restore this scenario before each independent task; do not reset between dialogue turns.

setup_requirements: Start api with two replicas and config v1 via envFrom.
Update api-config to v2 without changing the Pod template.
Expose a test observation of config_version via the application endpoint or startup logs.
All application replicas print config_version at startup; use local multi-architecture test images with deterministic health endpoints.
config_env_stale.reset: Restore this scenario before each independent task; do not reset between dialogue turns.

setup_requirements: Use a test worker that exits when CONFIG_ENDPOINT is absent.
missing_env.reset: Restore this scenario before each independent task; do not reset between dialogue turns.

setup_requirements: Create a reservation Pod with CPU requests leaving only 500m of allocatable CPU unreserved.
Create batch with requests.cpu=2000m; verify it is admitted but remains Pending with Insufficient cpu.
Do not use an admission-rejecting ResourceQuota as a substitute for FailedScheduling.
pending_cpu.reset: Restore this scenario before each independent task; do not reset between dialogue turns.

setup_requirements: Run a healthy HTTP app, but configure readinessProbe with a path returning 404.
bad_readiness.reset: Restore this scenario before each independent task; do not reset between dialogue turns.

setup_requirements: Create a healthy worker Deployment with two replicas and no HPA.
Ensure capacity for five small replicas.
scalable.reset: Restore this scenario before each independent task; do not reset between dialogue turns.

setup_requirements: Start api with two healthy replicas.
Change external startup configuration so replacement Pods fail readiness, while old running Pods keep their healthy startup configuration; do not modify the Deployment Pod template during setup.
A restart must start a rollout which cannot complete within the bounded tool timeout.
blocked_rollout.reset: Restore this scenario before each independent task; do not reset between dialogue turns.

setup_requirements: Create healthy web Pods and a Service whose selector does not match their labels.
service_selector.reset: Restore this scenario before each independent task; do not reset between dialogue turns.

setup_requirements: Block a conventional init container on an intentionally missing prerequisite.
init_wait.reset: Restore this scenario before each independent task; do not reset between dialogue turns.

setup_requirements: Create two healthy Deployments with different replica counts.
Record their Pod UIDs and Pod template fingerprints before each task.
two_frontends.reset: Restore this scenario before each independent task; do not reset between dialogue turns.

setup_requirements: Create two healthy Deployments whose names both contain api.
ambiguous_apis.reset: Restore this scenario before each independent task; do not reset between dialogue turns.

setup_requirements: Inject a single timeout after the restart request has been accepted by Kubernetes.
Expose the updated Pod template and rollout state to subsequent inspections.
Count writes independently of tool return values.
timeout_after_restart.reset: Restore this scenario before each independent task; do not reset between dialogue turns.

setup_requirements: Create one healthy api Pod.
Resolve aliases old_pod/new_pod to actual Pod names after setup; never hardcode generated names.
Expose config_version from api-config via startup logs; update the ConfigMap before replacing the Pod at t2.
pod_replaced.reset: Restore this scenario before each independent task; do not reset between dialogue turns.

setup_requirements: Create two healthy Deployments and capacity for five small replicas.
Keep control-worker unchanged throughout the dialogue.
long_scale.reset: Restore this scenario before each independent task; do not reset between dialogue turns.

setup_requirements: Start orders-api with a missing required environment variable.
Keep billing-api as an unchanged healthy control.
long_diagnosis.reset: Restore this scenario before each independent task; do not reset between dialogue turns.

fixture_requirements.environment: Dedicated local k3d cluster; one namespace agent-lab; scenarios run sequentially.
fixture_requirements.images: Build small local arm64-compatible test images; resolve and record image digests before actual evaluation.
fixture_requirements.snapshots: Record initial specs, Pod UIDs and actual names before each task; aliases are internal fixture references, not literal names for the model.
fixture_requirements.reset: Restore state before each task and between agents, but preserve state between turns of one dialogue.
fixture_requirements.validation: Assert each scenario precondition before starting an agent. A failed setup is a fixture error, not an agent failure.
fixture_requirements.isolation: Do not run two mutations/scenarios in the same namespace concurrently.
fixture_requirements.settling: After a tool says rollout complete, allow a bounded 60-second settling check for Pod termination and startup logs; timeout does not count as success.
